title: finlaysonia maritima
intro: Finlaysonia maritima, commonly known as the 'Sea Berry' or 'Tamil Odisa', is a plant species that belongs to the family Annonaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Finlaysonia maritima include its use in treating various health conditions like fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
